Containers.Name: Tesserafin
Containers.Description: Tesserafin is a free-software media server (a fork of Jellyfin). It manages and streams your own movies, shows, music and photos from your Unraid box to any device.[br][br] This template runs the prebuilt Tesserafin image from GHCR — no building from source. The server runs as the non-root user 10000:10000; the paths below are created and owned accordingly on first start.[br][br] [b]/config[/b] : server + network configuration, plugins, SSL, logs. [b]Back up.[/b][br] [b]/data[/b] : SQLite databases, metadata, collections, playlists, watch state. [b]Back up.[/b][br] [b]/cache[/b] : regenerable transcode/image cache. Disposable.[br] [b]/media[/b] : your library, mounted [b]READ-ONLY[/b]. Add more read-only media mappings as needed.[br][br] See the A3 guided-install guide and the A2 backup/restore note in the repository docs.
Containers.Overview: Tesserafin media server (Jellyfin fork). Streams your personal media library. Immutable pre-release image; dev tags do not auto-update.
